items.title: Show HN: Tickk – Voice task manager for brain dumps (offline, no AI, OSS)
items.raw_excerpt:
I built this because I have ADHD and kept losing ideas during brain dumps. You know that feeling when your thoughts are racing at 400 WPM but your fingers can only type 40? That's where ideas die. Most voice apps either require cloud processing or use AI that I can't audit. I wanted something that captures the chaos without judgment, then helps organize it later. What it does: Brain dump by voice → Web Speech API transcribes → compromise.js (deterministic NLP) sorts into tasks/notes
Everything runs client-side. No servers, no auth, no data collection.
Works offline via PWA + IndexedDB
Smart date detection: "tomorrow at 3pm" becomes an actual deadline
Priority detection, streak tracking, keyboard shortcuts
"Speak. Save. Sort it later." workflow
Tech stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind
W

On December 12, 2025, in Shanghai, China, the GDPS 2025 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and International Embodied Intelligence Skills Competition will officially commence. Promises about intelligence are made in spring, and answers about the body are harvested by year's end. It follows not the calendar seasons but the cycle of innovation—spring blossoms yield autumn fruits, and implementation reigns supreme. As the world's first top-tier competition in embodied intelligence fully benchmarked against the "WorldSkills" standards, this is not just a contest of technology but the ultimate test to verify whether silicon-based life can truly integrate into human production and daily life. According to Leifeng Wang, Q4 storage chip prices have shown a comprehensive upward trend, with the industry widely anticipating a large-scale release of storage demand from Q4 to Q2 of the following year. However, the current capacity expansion across the supply chain struggles to keep pace with demand growth, compounded by soaring storage medium costs, leading to a notable divergence: on one side, customers face a shortage of memory modules, while on the other, market pricing systems are in disarray—some second-tier storage manufacturers, convinced of further price increases, have even halted external quotes, temporarily arranged employee leave, and opted to stockpile goods to capitalize on larger price gaps. Despite this, in AI storage procurement decisions, memory efficiency remains the top priority, with cost factors taking a back seat, often second or third. items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we explore how Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology, enabling you to partition powerful GPUs into multiple isolated instances for running concurrent workloads like inference, research, and interactive development. By maximizing GPU utilization and reducing wasted resources, MIG helps organizations optimize costs while maintaining performance isolation and predictable quality of service across diverse machine learning tasks.
